text.tspan: Envoy consumes configuration strictly via path_config_source.
Zero network lookups during request execution.
1. 100% of live traffic continues routing to backends.
2. Zero packet loss during control plane outages.
3. Complete decoupling of data plane availability

text.tspan: Sequential Execution with Backward Compensation on Failure:
1. Reserve Hostname Lock in DynamoDB hostnames table (attribute_not_exists)
2. Request / Validate Certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)
3. Upsert Public/Private DNS Alias in Amazon Route 53 (points to NLB)
4. Provision / Associate Edge Distribution in Amazon CloudFront
5. Execute TCP Reachability Verification on Backend Host & Port
6. Mark Tenant ACTIVE in DynamoDB tenants table
* Compensation: On any step failure, preceding steps are undone in reverse order!
